claims.metric: relative water scarcity weight for a basin and month, index not dollars
claims.unit: dimensionless index (1 = world average remaining water per area)
claims.boundary: Weights a volume of water consumed by how little water remains per area after human and ecosystem demand; a consensus LCIA midpoint method aligned to ISO 14046. It is NOT a price and does not value any use of water. AWARE 2.0 (2025) also exists and was not opened beyond its abstract.
claims.quote: The CFs in this method range from 0.1 to 100 and can be applied to calculate water scarcity footprints. A CF value of 1 corresponds to regions with a remaining water availability per area over time that aligns with the world average
